title: Claim
description: A normalized atomic claim extracted from a raw source and appended to workspace/research-vault/knowledge/claims.jsonl. Claims are the lowest-level evidence unit; findings are built from one or more validated claims. Written by research-openclaw during extraction passes.

run_id.description: Run receipt ID of the research run that extracted this claim.

source_id.description: UUID of the source record in sources.jsonl this claim was extracted from.

claim_text.description: The atomic claim statement in plain language. Must be a single assertable proposition.

section.description: Section heading, page, or structural location within the source.

excerpt.description: Verbatim excerpt from which the claim was extracted.

char_offset.description: Optional character offset for precise provenance.

extraction_method.description: Method used to extract this claim.

normalized.description: Whether this claim has been normalized and deduplicated against existing claims.

promoted_to_finding_id.description: finding_id if this claim was promoted to a finding. Null if pending or rejected.

topic.description: Domain topic this claim belongs to. Should match findings topic taxonomy.

examples.claim_text: W3C trace context specification requires vendors to propagate traceparent headers across all asynchronous boundaries.

extracted_from.excerpt: Vendors MUST propagate trace context headers across async boundaries.
